member.name: T:EasyLog.IDailyLogger
member.summary: Appends log entries to a daily log file. Designed to be reusable across multiple ProSoft applications. Implementations must be thread-safe and must preserve the v1.0 contract for backward compatibility with existing consumers.

member.name: M:EasyLog.IDailyLogger.Append(EasyLog.LogEntry)
member.summary: Appends a single log entry to the current day log file. A new file is created automatically when the date changes.
member.param: The log entry to append. Must not be null.

member.name: T:EasyLog.ILogFormatter
member.summary: Serializes a to the textual representation used in daily log files. Concrete formatters are introduced in EasyLog v2 to support both JSON and XML outputs without changing the v1 contract.
member.remarks: Implementations must be thread-safe and pure: may be called from concurrent backup jobs and must not mutate shared state.

member.name: M:EasyLog.ILogFormatter.Format(EasyLog.LogEntry)
member.summary: Returns the serialized representation of .
member.param: The log entry to serialize. Must not be null.
member.returns: The serialized text, ready to append to the daily log file.

member.name: P:EasyLog.ILogFormatter.FileExtension
member.summary: File extension (including the leading dot) used by daily log files produced by this formatter, e.g. ".json" or ".xml".

member.name: T:EasyLog.JsonDailyLogger
member.summary: Writes instances to a daily JSON file named "yyyy-MM-dd.json" inside a configurable directory. Each file contains a JSON array of entries appended over the day. Writes are serialized with a lock to stay safe under concurrent calls and performed atomically via a temporary file to avoid partial writes. Note: each append rewrites the whole day file (O(n) on the daily count); this is acceptable for v1.0 volumes and can be revisited later if needed.

member.name: M:EasyLog.JsonDailyLogger.#ctor(System.String)
member.summary: Initializes a new logger writing to . The directory is created if it does not exist.
member.param: Absolute or UNC path where daily files are stored.
member.exception: Thrown when the path is null or empty.

member.name: P:EasyLog.JsonDailyLogger.LogDirectory
member.summary: Absolute path of the directory where daily log files are written.

member.name: T:EasyLog.JsonFormatter
member.summary: Serializes a to its JSON representation for the daily JSON log file. Symmetric to : both honor so callers can swap formats by configuration.

remarks.para: The output is a single JSON object — the daily logger is responsible for assembling these objects into the JSON array stored in the daily file.
Backward compatibility with v1 is guaranteed by : is annotated to be omitted when null, so a v2 entry without encryption produces the exact same JSON shape as a v1 entry.

member.name: P:EasyLog.LogEntry.EncryptionTimeMs
member.summary: Encryption duration in milliseconds (EasyLog v2+). A negative value indicates an encryption failure. Null when no encryption was performed (default for v1 consumers).
member.remarks: The property is omitted from the JSON output when null so that v1 consumers reading the log file see the exact same shape as before.

member.name: T:EasyLog.XmlDailyLogger
member.summary: Writes instances to a daily XML file named "yyyy-MM-dd.xml" inside a configurable directory. Each file is a valid document with a <Logs> root element and one <Entry> child per logged operation, conforming to the schema in EasyLog.Schemas.easysave-log.xsd. Writes are serialized with a lock and performed atomically via a temporary file so concurrent backup jobs never corrupt the daily file.

member.param: Absolute or UNC path where daily XML files are stored.
member.exception: Thrown when the path is null or empty.

member.name: P:EasyLog.XmlDailyLogger.LogDirectory
member.summary: Absolute path of the directory where daily log files are written.

member.name: T:EasyLog.XmlFormatter
member.summary: Serializes a as an <Entry> XML fragment for the daily XML log file required by EasySave v2.
member.remarks: The fragment is meant to be appended under a <Logs> root element produced by the daily logger. The accompanying schema (embedded as EasyLog.Schemas.easysave-log.xsd) describes the full document.

member.name: M:EasyLog.XmlFormatter.LoadSchema
member.summary: Loads the XSD schema describing the daily XML log document (<Logs> with zero or more <Entry> children).
